item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Westwood solidifies top spot in Austin Boys rankings
item.description: With two more wins over ranked teams, including a convincing road win over their nearest district competitor in Vandegrift, the Westwood Warriors have seized control over the Boys Power Rankings at (roughly) the halfway mark in district play. Because Westlake looked stronger in their two wins than did Lake Travis last week, the Chaps reclaimed the #2 spot over the Cavs with Bowie joining the 26-6A parade at #4. item.title: THE POWER RANKINGS: Westlake rolls, to remain on top of Austin area Girls Rankings
item.description: While there were several good district clashes lost week, there wasn’t a lot of movement in this week’s Girls Power Rankings. Westlake blasted two more opponents to remain on top and close in on a 30-win season.Liberty Hill, Glenn and Vandegrift remain #2-#4 despite Liberty Hill’s loss to a rapidly improving Cedar Park club.
